en: A black and white postcard image showing a street in ruins, with debris and damaged buildings lining both sides. Two figures walk down the middle of the street, which appears to have been devastated by a recent fire. The text on the postcard is in both French and English, referencing a fire in Salonique (Thessaloniki) in August 1917 and mentioning the Rue Frangue and the English Post Office.
